title: .Net Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular)


Salary: $5,500 – $6,500 USD per month (based on experience)

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (EST)

Location: Fully remote (Latin America)


Latino Legends is conducting a search on behalf of one of our innovative, fast-growing clients in the marketing and digital delivery space.


Our client is a technology-driven marketing organization that builds and scales high-performance digital platforms for global brands. They specialize in developing advanced marketing systems, product delivery solutions, and integrated digital experiences that support microsites, social media, and complex backend operations. The company is known for embracing modern technologies, agile practices, and continuous innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Full Stack Developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to play a key role across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).


The Role


As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key contributor to the client’s technology team. You will go beyond implementation—helping architect, design, and scale applications that power a global digital ecosystem. From backend services to modern frontend interfaces, your work will directly impact performance, scalability, and user experience.


Technical Qualifications & Requirements


  • Experience: 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core/MVC, and Entity Framework. Experience designing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Frontend Expertise: Advanced experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Angular (v12+), including state management, component architecture, and performance optimization.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, plus cloud platforms such as Azure (preferred) or AWS/GCP. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Software Craftsmanship: Solid understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, unit testing/TDD, and Agile/SCRUM methodologies.
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Comfortable mentoring teammates, participating in code reviews, and contributing to best practices within distributed teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect and develop scalable, high-quality applications using modern .NET and Angular frameworks.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Maintain high standards for code quality through documentation, testing, and peer reviews.
  • Research and implement new technologies to keep the platform modern and competitive.


Why Join This Opportunity?


  • Modern, cloud-native technology stack with minimal legacy constraints.
  • Collaborative, professional work environment with high technical standards.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
  • Strong work-life balance with PTO and recognized holidays.

description:

  • Prover soluções técnicas para o desenvolvimento de novas features e dar suporte às features já existentes;

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções backend utilizando microserviços e computação serverless, garantindo escalabilidade, alta disponibilidade e resiliência;
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir APIs REST e integrações assíncronas com mensagerias;
  • Projetar e implementar soluções backend em Node, utilizando frameworks MVC, bancos de dados relacionais e padrões arquiteturais adequados ao domínio do negócio;
  • Garantir a qualidade contínua do software por meio da implementação de testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia de software, reduzindo débitos técnicos e aumentando a manutenibilidade das aplicações.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência obrigatória e vivência em projetos com Azure Logic Apps
  • Experiência com Node;
  • Habilidade em lógica de programação;
  • Experiência em desenho e detalhamento de soluções técnicas;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em computação Serverless (Azure Functions e AWS Lambda);
  • Vivência prática na implementação de microserviços com comunicação síncrona e assíncrona, em cenários complexos e de alta performance;
  • Conhecimento de ao menos um framework MVC;
  • Experiência profissional com mensageria (SQS, SNS, RabbitMQ ou Kafka), com boa base teórica em tópicos e filas;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL);
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST;

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Scrum Master - Fully Remote
description:
Scrum Master – Fully Remote


We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support our software and network development teams. You will be responsible for guiding teams in agile principles and practices, removing obstacles, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.


Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies – daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Coach team members in agile practices and Scrum values to ensure consistent application.
  • Foster collaboration between developers, testers, product owners, and stakeholders.
  • Promote transparency and effective communication within and across teams.
  • Facilitate cross-team coordination when multiple Scrum teams are working on related products or features.


Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Scrum Master working with software development teams.
  • Strong understanding of Agile frameworks and principles.
  • Must have experience working in Telecommunications.
  • Excellent facilitation, conflict resolution, and coaching skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Ability to work in a hectic environment.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PSM I/II, or equivalent certification.
  • Familiarity with Scaled Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe, LeSS).
  • Background in software development or QA (is a plus).

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Title: Salesforce Developer (4856)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: 6+ Months Contract


Pay: BRL 150-160/hr.


Position Summary

The role of the Salesforce Developer is to create new functionality using declarative (e.g. Formula Fields, Process Builder, Flow) or programmatic (e.g. Apex, Visualforce) methods to meet business requirements. The position has the responsibility for researching solutions, troubleshooting bugs, and enhancing the capabilities of Salesforce within best practices guidelines. In addition to understanding technical aspects of Salesforce such as Integration APIs and data security architecture, the role requires analytical problem solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to set push back against unreasonable expectations.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Drive the creation of application and technical design documents which leverage Salesforce best practices
  • Solve complex issues using troubleshooting methodologies combined with expert knowledge of Salesforce applications.
  • Work closely with Business Analysts using Agile development techniques to understand requirements and build high quality solutions
  • Develop application fixes for critical issues with declarative (Workflows, Approvals, Formulas, etc…) and programmatic tools (Apex Classes, Triggers, Visualforce, Lightning, etc…)
  • Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party partners
  • Proactively research, present and make recommendations regarding new features made available with each Salesforce release.
  • Perform review of code in collaboration with Administrators, to ensure long term viability & integrity.
  • Make recommendations for enhancements and modifications to improve system performance, efficiency and reporting.
  • Collaborate with team members in a virtual team environment to extend field experience to different geographies.
  • Contribute to the development and management of knowledge-sharing methodologies, diagnostic tools, and creative processes, to improve the end user experience.
  • Be a pro-active contributor to a 24x7x365 running support organization, this will require working flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays and monitoring email regularly outside standard business hours.


Additional Duties & Responsibilities

  • Review technical solutions and documentation developed by other team members
  • Mentor and cross train other team members


Minimal Qualifications

  • Platform Developer I Certification
  • Platform Developer II Certification
  • Platform App Builder Certification
  • Experience in Lightning Web Components


Education

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience


Experience

  • Minimum combined 10 years development experience with CRM applications with 4+ years of hands-on development with Salesforce
  • 4+ years of development in medium to large complexity Salesforce Orgs
  • Deep expertise of Salesforce architecture, administration, best practices, and CRM business concepts.
  • Experience with post-production managed services and support


Skills

  • Hands on Development with Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation and communication skills – verbal & written. Ability to communicate at business level with stakeholders and technical level with developers.
  • Practical knowledge of APIs to integrate Salesforce with other data sources.
  • Expertise in customization of Mobile App.
  • Superb trouble-shooting skills and tenacity in problem solving.
  • Strong knowledge of key application functionality, data security, and relationships.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to work calmly and professionally in high pressure situations.
  • The ability to work effectively from a home-based office in a virtual environment.


Desired Qualifications

  • Integration Architecture Designer Certification
  • Certified Sharing and Visibility Designer
  • A consulting background, while not mandatory, would be useful
  • 2+ Years of Experience in DevOps Environment

title: UX Designer - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: UX Designer - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência com UX/UI Design (Prototipação);
  • Experiência com rotinas da área de UX Writer;
  • Conhecimento sobre experiência do usuário e teste de usabilidade;
  • Vivência com UX Research.


Formação: superior completo ou cursando na área de TI.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Required Skills:


  • Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • 5+ years of industry experience.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Multi-year experience as a full-stack engineer using modern technologies.
  • Experience with Java, Go, and JavaScript frameworks, including Sencha ExtJS.
  • Experience developing applications with SQL databases.
  • Experience with J2EE or JBoss/Wildfly.
  • Strong working knowledge of REST API or GraphQL.
  • Solid understanding of distributed computing and cloud computing concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with QA and remote teams.


Desired Skills:


  • Experience coding in Python.
  • Experience designing consumer-facing products.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with network products, including switches, routers, wireless controllers, and access points.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Node/React Fullstack Developer | Senior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Procurar sempre criar a melhor experiência de uso para o usuário final, trabalhando de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, designers e stakeholders para garantir o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente na resolução de problemas complexos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções inovadoras;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, de fácil manutenção, utilizando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de revisão de código, atuando tanto como revisor quanto como autor, garantindo a qualidade e a funcionalidade das features desenvolvidas;
  • Acompanhar o comportamento das aplicações em produção usando as principais métricas de saúde e performance disponíveis nas ferramentas de monitoração, buscando insights de melhorias e entendendo anomalias a partir dessas métricas;
  • Atuar no backend que é a interface de consumo dos dados para todos os front-ends, garantindo resiliência e suporte à alta carga de acessos simultâneos;
  • Contribuir com a aplicação responsável pela entrega do site web do produto, utilizando o ambiente como campo de experimentação e aprendizado sobre o comportamento dos usuários.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Conhecimentos sólidos de NodeJS e React
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de HTML e CSS;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos do sistema de controle de versão Git;
  • Visão sobre design patterns (Criacionais, Estruturais e Comportamentais);
  • Domínio de boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (DRY, KISS, TDA, SoC, SOLID);
  • Experiência com testes unitários em JavaScript;
  • Domínio de design de APIs REST (preferencialmente com o framework Express);
  • Visão do modelo arquitetural de micro-serviços;
  • Experiência com design responsivo (media queries, propriedades relativas, flexbox, CSS grid);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de JavaScript e domínio dos paradigmas orientado a objetos e funcional da linguagem;
  • Conhecimento sobre GraphQL (preferencialmente com o framework Apollo);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoração (métricas de performance e erros);
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de hint/lint (preferencialmente ESLint).

title: Young Professional – IT Recruiter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Young Professional – IT Recruiter position focuses on launching your career in talent acquisition within a global tech company. This role involves supporting end-to-end recruitment processes and developing sourcing and interviewing skills alongside experienced recruiters. You'll participate in the full recruitment cycle from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination while building talent pipelines and collaborating with hiring teams.


Key responsibilities


- Supporting the full recruitment cycle, from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination.

- Sourcing candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, and other platforms to build a strong talent pipeline.

- Reviewing resumes and conducting initial screening calls to assess candidate profiles and interest.

- Coordinating interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a smooth experience for all parties.

- Maintaining and updating candidate records in the ATS, keeping data accurate and up to date.

- Collaborating with senior recruiters and hiring teams to understand role requirements and refine search strategies.


Requirements


- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field — or currently pursuing one.

- Career Interest: Strong interest in IT recruitment and talent acquisition.

- Professional Attitude: Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Core Skills: Good communication and interpersonal skills.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Security-minded approach to development

Experience with microservices architecture

Ability to own projects from concept to production

title: Python Developer (Junior) - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role


The Junior Python Developer will build and maintain Python applications while strengthening software development expertise in a collaborative environment. This role focuses on learning Python best practices, contributing to development projects, and growing technical skills under the guidance of experienced engineers.


Key Responsibilities:


- Developing and maintaining Python applications and components under guidance from senior developers.

- Writing clean code and participating in code reviews to learn best practices.

- Collaborating with team members to implement features and resolve technical issues.

- Supporting testing and debugging efforts to ensure application quality.

- Learning and applying Python frameworks, tools, and development methodologies.

- Contributing to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team.


Requirements:


- Python Experience: 1+ year of Python development.

- Basic understanding of Python fundamentals and object-oriented programming.

- Familiarity with web development concepts and database basics.

- Knowledge of version control systems and collaborative development workflows.

- Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

- Language: Advanced level of English.


What to Expect from Us:


- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Competitive Compensation: Excellent payment in USD or your preferred local currency.

- Home Office Setup: Complete hardware provision for your workspace.

- Flexible Hours: Design your own work schedule for optimal work-life balance.

- Paid Leave: Parental leave, vacation, and national holidays.

- Dynamic Work Culture: Innovative and multicultural environment.

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Modelar arquiteturas de software em nuvem;
  • Ter conhecimento das tecnologias utilizadas pela equipe;
  • Ter capacidade de medir esforços e definir prazos de implementação;

  • Solucionar problemas que surgem durante os projetos;
  • Habilidade de gerenciar conflitos e expectativas;
  • Proatividade.

Hard Skills:

  • Experiencia com nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc) (Mínimo de 1 ano);
  • Experiência com .NET (C#) (Mais de 3 anos);
  • Experience com banco de dados relacional (SQLServer, MySql, Postgres) (Mais de 3 anos);
  • Design Patterns;
  • Experiência com testes unitários (TDD);
  • Conhecimento em GIT;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum);
  • Conhecimento em Docker, Kubernets;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de messageria (Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, etc..);
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Capacidade de escrever código robusto, testável e validado;
  • Conhecimento em aplicações que precisem responder em alta disponibilidade e alta performance.



Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento de Mercado Financeiro;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality (sonar);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de APM (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, DataDog, etc...);
  • Conhecimento em Prometheus, metricas e monitoramento;
  • Experiência com aplicações SPA;
  • Conhecimento em ElasticSearch, Apache Lucene e GraphQL;
  • Experiência trabalhando com implantação e gerenciamento de nuvem;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento e implantação de CI/CD.



Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cut-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role:


The Career Framework Specialist plays a crucial role in designing and maintaining organizational talent structures, translating complex role dynamics into clear, scalable career paths. You'll bring clarity to organizational complexity by crafting intuitive job architectures that support talent growth and alignment.


Key Responsibilities:


- Designing and maintaining career paths, leveling frameworks, and job families for Talent roles.

- Building and updating role definitions, responsibilities, and seniority distinctions.

- Ensuring consistency, clarity, and scalability across all Talent-related structures.

- Partnering with Talent Acquisition Leaders to align role frameworks with business needs.

- Documenting and communicating updates in a clear, structured, and globally usable way.

- Supporting audits and Talent processes by keeping role architectures accurate and standardized.


Requirements:


- Experience: 3+ years in Organizational Development, Talent Management, HR Business Analysis, or Job Architecture.

- Design Skills: Proven experience designing career paths, job families, or role architectures.

- Analytical Ability: Strong capability to analyze and structure information into clear frameworks.

- Communication: Excellent written communication and documentation skills.

- Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional HR or Talent teams.

- Technical Skills: Advanced experience with Excel/Google Sheets and documentation tools.


Desired Tools Experience:


- Documentation platforms like Notion or Confluence.

- Flowchart/mapping tools such as Miro or Lucidchart.


Personal Attributes:


- Systems and structural thinking.

- Passion for clarity and logical problem-solving.

- Ability to translate complex information into intuitive frameworks.

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

- Skill in collaborating across multiple stakeholders.


What to Expect from Us:


- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Competitive Compensation: Excellent payment in USD or your preferred local currency.

- Home Office Setup: Complete hardware provision for your workspace.

- Flexible Hours: Design your own work schedule for optimal work-life balance.

- Paid Leave: Parental leave, vacation, and national holidays.

- Dynamic Work Culture: Innovative and multicultural environment.

- Elite Collaboration: Work with the global top 1% of talent.

- Growth and Support: Mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, do not hesitate to apply!


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Scrum Master - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Scrum Master - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em times ágeis de desenvolvimento, testes, suporte, infraestrutura e manutenção, com atuação em ágil convencional e ágil escalado.
  • Domínio de Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, métricas ágeis e CI/CD.
  • Capacidade de facilitar cerimônias, orientar times, remover impedimentos, promover padrões ágeis e utilizar indicadores para garantir a qualidade, apoiar ações estratégicas e induzir a evolução e a melhoria contínua.
  • Certificações ágeis são desejáveis.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Customer Success | Onboarding
description:
LEIA A DESCRIÇÃO!


Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário:


NOSSO JEITO DE SER E FAZER ⚡

O time da PayConductor é feito por pessoas obcecadas por resolver problemas reais de pagamentos: gente que entende que cada décimo de ponto na taxa de aprovação representa milhões na ponta dos nossos clientes. Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando.


Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui.


E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente?

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: PJ


Buscamos por um(a) Senior Data Scientist para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados na Ambev, com foco em modelagem preditiva e desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas voltadas a churn, propensão, risco e previsão de eventos futuros .

– Entender problemas de negócio e traduzi-los em soluções analíticas e preditivas;

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
SENIOR GO ENGINEER | SERIES A FINTECH START-UP | REMOTE IN LATAM | $120k USD


Realm is partnered with a high-growth fintech building who have recently secured a huge Series A round and is looking to grow its team.


They're developing a payment fraud detection platform to rapidly identify and prevent fraudulent transactions. The platform will automatically detect suspicious activity and potential perpetrators, significantly reducing response times.


Who they're looking for: A backend engineer with exceptional Go programming skills (min 2 years of commercial Go experience) and a strong foundation in databases, gRPC, and scalable system architecture.


You'll work on complex problems in fintech, risk, and fraud, and have the opportunity to join an exceptional remotely distributed team of 6 who are re-inventing fraud detection.


Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for chargeback management, integrating with credit card, banking, and merchant platforms.
  • Design and implement robust microservices architecture, leveraging reusable frameworks and libraries.
  • Optimize system performance and security by leading code improvement, CI/CD enhancement, and technology upgrades.
  • Drive platform innovation by identifying improvement areas and owning feature development from inception to deployment.


Ideal candidate:

  • 6+ years of software development experience, with at least 2 years in Go production environments.
  • Proven experience in platform architecture and development.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, including leading complex projects.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and deep technical knowledge.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.


Tech stack: Go, DynamoDB, gRPC, Docker, SNS/Kafka (not exhaustive)


Tags:

Go, FinTech, Fraud, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Finance, Backend, Engineering, Software

title: Cloud Solutions Architect with Azure or AWS  (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of experience;
  • Experience with Cloud platforms (Azure and/or AWS);
  • Solid knowledge of Microservices architecture;
  • Experience working with REST, SOAP, and APIs;
  • Experience with Kafka (Nice to have);
  • Fluency in English (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!


The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (C#/.NET)
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.

At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer with experience with C#/.NET and frontend TypeScript to work as a consultant out of our South American Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we expand our collaboration with one of our fastest growing North American SaaS clients.

A successful candidate in this role is capable of writing rock solid code, as well as collaborating effectively with Business Analysts and Product Managers to ensure the requirements of the business are being met.


Key Responsibilities
  • Embed within existing client development team and maintain high standards of code quality and development best practices
  • Develop, test, and deploy high-quality web applications and services using the .NET stack
  • Partner with business analysts to align on requirements, define technical scope, and drive project delivery — proactively manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations across the team
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices and design patterns (e.g., SOLID principles, Dependency Injection)
  • Participate in all phases of the agile development lifecycle, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, code reviews, and retrospectives
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing software to ensure optimal performance and security
  • Contribute to technical documentation for new and existing features
  • Mentor and support junior and mid level developers on the team


Must Have Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software engineer
  • 2+ years of experience with C#/.NET 8+
  • Experience with .NET Framework 4.8
  • Experience with Azure cloud
  • Experience with SQL Server and Relational Databases
  • Experience with TypeScript and frontend web frameworks like Angular
  • Strong OOP knowledge


Nice to Have Skills:

  • Exposure to test automation tools such as XUnit, Moq, Autofac, Postman
  • Exposure to observability tools such as DataDog, Serilog, and OpenTelemetry
  • Exposure to containerization and Infrastructure as Code
  • Exposure to Domain Driven Design principles
  • Experience working with Azure Blob Storage and DocumentDB for unstructured and document-based data storage.
  • Openness to contributing, at least part of the time, to legacy projects in PHP and Angular
  • ​​Exposure to GitHub Actions


Benefits:

  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with basic Golang skills to support a team focused on improving development processes and the product. In this role, you will work closely with a Staff Engineer building with a focus on designing, migrating, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and cloud environments that enable these systems to operate reliably and at scale.


Your work will involve containerized services, AWS Lambda, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and secure data transfer between AWS accounts , with a strong emphasis on scalability, security, and operational excellence.


You will collaborate with engineering, product, and operational teams, while also coordinating technical requirements with the vendor. Strong communication skills are important, as you’ll often act as the bridge between the team and other internal teams, ensuring infrastructure and systems are aligned with internal standards and best practices.



What we’re looking for:


● Strong AWS and DevOps experience (infrastructure, deployments, operations, observability)


● Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred)


● Experience with containerized environments (Docker, ECS/EKS, etc.)


● Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda and related cloud tooling


● Golang and Bash skills for scripting, automation, and backend support


● Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple stakeholders


● Strong communication and coordination skills



Nice to have:

● Familiarity with TypeScript or Node.js


This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working towards engineering excellence and helping the team excel. You will collaborate across infrastructure and development teams to deliver impactful solutions.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Consultor SAP Group Reporting (GR) Sênior
description:
Consultor SAP Group Reporting (GR) Sênior


Data de Início: Imediata

Contrato de Trabalho: PJ ou via Cooperativa

Tempo de Alocação: 2 meses (a ser confirmado)

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário de Trabalho: 9h00 às 18h00

Taxa hora: A ser negociado


Visão Geral da Posição:


Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) SAP Group Reporting (GR) Sênior com perfil altamente técnico e funcional, para atuar em um contexto de consolidação financeira, fechamento contábil e atendimento às demandas de reporte corporativo em ambiente SAP S/4HANA.


O profissional será responsável por apoiar a implementação, sustentação e evolução da solução de Group Reporting, garantindo consistência dos dados financeiros, aderência às normas contábeis e compliance regulatório. Atuará em interface direta com áreas de Controladoria, Contabilidade e TI, contribuindo para a confiabilidade dos processos de fechamento e consolidação.


Espera-se autonomia, visão de negócio, capacidade analítica e atuação orientada a prazos críticos, especialmente em ciclos de fechamento.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Atuar na implementação, sustentação e evolução de soluções em SAP Group Reporting (S/4HANA);
  • Conduzir processos de consolidação financeira, assegurando integridade e consistência dos dados;
  • Configurar e manter regras de consolidação, incluindo eliminações intercompany e ajustes manuais;
  • Apoiar ciclos de fechamento contábil, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e qualidade das entregas;
  • Atuar na validação e reconciliação de dados financeiros provenientes de diferentes entidades;
  • Gerenciar estruturas organizacionais de consolidação (grupos, unidades, hierarquias);
  • Utilizar e dar suporte aos processos de Data Collection, Data Monitor e Consolidation Monitor;
  • Realizar troubleshooting funcional e técnico em cenários de inconsistência ou divergência de dados;
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio (Controladoria / Contábil) na análise de resultados e reportes;
  • Garantir aderência às normas contábeis (IFRS / US GAAP) e políticas corporativas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência sólida com SAP Group Reporting em ambiente S/4HANA;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em processos de consolidação financeira;
  • Experiência prática em fechamento contábil e reporte gerencial;
  • Experiência com configuração de regras de consolidação e eliminações intercompany;
  • Conhecimento em estruturas de consolidação (grupos e unidades consolidadas);
  • Forte entendimento de dados financeiros (FI);
  • Experiência em validação, reconciliação e consistência de dados;
  • Vivência em interação com áreas de negócio (Controladoria e Contabilidade);
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos ou consultorias;
  • Português fluente.


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência em projetos de implementação de SAP Group Reporting;
  • Conhecimento em SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI);
  • Experiência com Data Collection, Data Monitor e Consolidation Monitor;
  • Conhecimento em normas contábeis internacionais (IFRS / US GAAP);
  • Experiência com integração com SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) para planejamento e reporting;
  • Vivência em projetos internacionais;
  • Inglês para leitura de documentação e interação com times globais.


Formação e Experiência:


  • Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia, TI ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de consolidação financeira;
  • Vivência prática com SAP S/4HANA, especialmente no contexto financeiro;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos ou consultorias especializadas.


Competências Comportamentais:


  • Perfil analítico, com forte atenção a detalhes;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada com áreas técnicas e financeiras;
  • Organização e gestão eficiente de prazos, especialmente em períodos de fechamento;
  • Proatividade e autonomia na condução de atividades;
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em cenários críticos;
  • Visão de negócio aplicada a processos financeiros.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with \"agentic\" workflows, turning complex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the \"Human-in-the-Loop\" patterns for our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.


Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma , including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and \"developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI \"thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.


What We’re Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Consultor(a) de Estruturação de Cargos e Salários (PJ)
description:
Sobre o desafio

Buscamos um(a) profissional com experiência em estruturação de cargos e salários para conduzir um projeto estratégico de revisão e implementação da arquitetura organizacional da empresa.

Essa pessoa será responsável por organizar, padronizar e dar clareza às estruturas de cargos, trilhas de carreira e políticas de remuneração, garantindo maior equidade interna e competitividade com o mercado. Vaga temporária de 3 meses.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar diagnóstico da estrutura atual de cargos e salários
  • Mapear e descrever cargos (job descriptions) em conjunto com as lideranças
  • Criar e/ou revisar plano de cargos, salários e carreiras (PCCS)
  • Desenvolver tabelas salariais e faixas de remuneração
  • Conduzir análises de equidade interna e benchmarking de mercado
  • Apoiar na definição de políticas de remuneração fixa e variável
  • Estruturar critérios de progressão e movimentação interna
  • Apresentar recomendações estratégicas para diretoria/gestão
  • Apoiar na comunicação e implementação do projeto

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em estruturação de cargos e salários
  • Vivência com projetos de PCCS do zero ou reestruturação
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de avaliação de cargos (ex: Hay, Mercer, etc.)
  • Experiência com análise de mercado e construção de tabelas salariais
  • Excel avançado (ou ferramentas de análise de dados)
  • Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em consultorias ou projetos múltiplos
  • Vivência em empresas em crescimento ou reestruturação
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de RH/People Analytics

Perfil comportamental

  • Autonomia e senso de dono
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de influenciar lideranças
  • Organização e foco em entrega
  • Visão crítica e orientada a solução

Entregáveis esperados (ao final dos 3 meses)

  • Estrutura de cargos definida e documentada
  • Tabela salarial estruturada e validada
  • Política de remuneração formalizada
  • Recomendações estratégicas para evolução do modelo

Observação

Projeto com alto impacto organizacional, ideal para profissionais que gostam de estruturar, organizar e deixar legado.

title: Remote Bookkeeper
description:
A Income Tax Plus Inc é um escritório profissional de contabilidade localizado em Framingham, Massachusetts, especializado em bookkeeping, contabilidade, preparação de impostos e relatórios financeiros para pessoas físicas e empresas. Nosso foco é oferecer serviços financeiros de alta qualidade, com precisão, organização e atendimento personalizado.

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Bookkeeper / Auxiliar Contábil para atuar em regime presencial e tempo integral . O(a) profissional será responsável por manter registros financeiros precisos, apoiar operações contábeis diárias e colaborar com a equipe de contabilidade e impostos. Buscamos alguém organizado, detalhista e com experiência prática em rotinas contábeis.

Responsabilidades

  • Manter registros financeiros organizados e atualizados
  • Preparar e revisar demonstrações financeiras
  • Lançar e reconciliar journal entries (lançamentos contábeis)
  • Trabalhar com softwares contábeis (ex.: QuickBooks, similares)
  • Garantir conformidade com normas contábeis e financeiras
  • Auxiliar nos processos de preparação de impostos (tax preparation)
  • Apoiar as operações financeiras e administrativas do escritório

Qualificações

  • Experiência em bookkeeping, contabilidade e lançamentos contábeis
  • Conhecimento em financeiro, conciliações e relatórios contábeis
  • Domínio de softwares de contabilidade (QuickBooks é um diferencial)
  • Atenção aos detalhes e alto nível de organização
  • Conhecimento em impostos nos EUA é um diferencial
  • Graduação em Contabilidade, Finanças ou área relacionada (preferencial)
  • Boa gestão de tempo e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho 100% remoto

Por que trabalhar na Income Tax Plus Inc

  • Vaga estável em tempo integral
  • Ambiente profissional, colaborativo e respeitoso
  • Oportunidade de crescimento na área contábil e fiscal
  • Experiência prática com clientes individuais e empresariais


  • Interessados podem se candidatar diretamente pelo LinkedIn ou entrar em contato conosco para mais informações.
