title: Especialista de Conteúdo
description:
ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO

  • 100% remoto
  • Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição
  • Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar
  • Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento


SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


E agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real.

Na prática, isso significa:

  • Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. 
  • Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. 
  • Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL.
  • IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca.
  • Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades.
  • Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth.
  • Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto.
  • Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca.
  • Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias.
  • Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair.
  • Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo.
  • Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca.
  • Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a).
  • Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho.
  • Comunicação direta, pública e clara.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Automação de marketing e CRM.

title: Engenheiro DevOps (inglês fluente)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:


• Instalar, configurar, administrar e dar suporte a sistemas e serviços de Core Banking em diferentes ambientes (DEV/UAT/PROD).

• Automatizar atividades operacionais e de deploy utilizando Rundeck e Ansible (orquestração de jobs, playbooks/roles, inventários e gerenciamento seguro de credenciais).

• Criar e manter runbooks, procedimentos operacionais e documentação padrão para permitir execuções repetíveis e auditáveis.

• Fornecer suporte à produção e participar da resposta a incidentes, incluindo triagem, correção e análises pós-incidente (RCA/gestão de problemas).

• Monitorar a saúde e o desempenho dos sistemas; implementar melhorias proativas em disponibilidade, resiliência e capacidade.

• Gerenciar configuração, aplicação de patches e ciclo de vida de componentes de sistema operacional, middleware e aplicações, garantindo conformidade com controles internos.

• Coordenar o controle, renovação e implantação de certificados digitais (ex.: TLS/SSL), incluindo inventário, monitoramento de vencimento, planejamento de mudanças, validação e documentação para evitar interrupções de serviço.

• Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

• Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

• Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

• Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.


Requisitos:

• Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras; conhecimento do mercado financeiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

• Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

• Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

• Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

• Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

• Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

• Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

• Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders; capacidade de trabalhar com fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejável:

• Experiência com SAFe; exposição ao GCP.

• Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

• Espanhol.

• Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

• Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

• Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

• Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.

• Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras; conhecimento do mercado financeiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

• Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

• Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

• Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

• Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

• Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

• Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

• Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders; capacidade de trabalhar com fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejável:

• Experiência com SAFe; exposição ao GCP.

• Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

• Espanhol.

title: Atendimento Comercial (Remoto)
description:
New Patient & Lead Conversion Specialist | Appointment Setter | Lead Conversion (Phone + SMS)


Looking for a role where your communication skills directly impact people’s lives and business growth?


We’re hiring a New Patient & Lead Conversion Specialist to own the first interaction with potential patients, convert leads into appointments, and drive results through phone and SMS.

If you have experience with lead conversion, appointment setting, phone sales, and CRM management , this role puts you at the center of growth.


About the Company

We are a fast-growing healthcare and wellness clinic focused on helping patients find real, lasting health solutions. Every first interaction matters, and you’ll play a key role in that experience.


What You’ll Do

  • Handle inbound calls and convert leads into booked appointments
  • Follow up with warm and cold leads (calls + SMS)
  • Manage conversations and pipeline inside CRM (Go HighLevel)
  • Respond quickly and guide leads toward booking
  • Ensure a strong, professional first impression


What Success Looks Like

  • High lead-to-appointment conversion rate
  • Fast response time (calls and SMS)
  • Fully booked schedules
  • Consistent follow-up with all leads
  • Positive patient feedback


Requirements (Must-Have)

  • Fluent English (spoken and written)
  • Experience with lead conversion, appointment setting, or phone sales
  • Strong communication and rapport-building skills
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Self-motivated and performance-driven


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Go HighLevel CRM or similar
  • Background in healthcare, wellness, or service-based businesses


Who You Are

  • Confident on the phone and action-oriented
  • Goal-driven and results-focused
  • Positive, proactive, and accountable
  • Genuinely interested in helping people


Work Model

  • Full-Time (40h/week)
  • Monday to Friday
  • 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM (MST)
  • Remote


Contract Type

  • PJ


Compensation

  • Salary + performance incentives

title: Banco de Talentos GFT -  Desenvolvimento ServiceNow
description:
Banco de Talentos | Desenvolvimento ServiceNow


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de ServiceNow, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em automação de processos, transformação digital e melhoria da experiência do usuário.


Se você busca trabalhar com uma plataforma líder em workflows e gestão de serviços, criando soluções escaláveis e integradas, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui


  • Desenvolver e customizar soluções na plataforma ServiceNow;
  • Criar workflows, automações e aplicações utilizando o ServiceNow;
  • Atuar com desenvolvimento de scripts (server-side e client-side);
  • Trabalhar com criação e customização de módulos, formulários e catálogos de serviços;
  • Integrar o ServiceNow com outros sistemas e APIs;
  • Atuar em diferentes módulos (ITSM, ITOM, HR, CSM, entre outros);
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, governança e performance;
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (negócio, produto, engenharia);
  • Participar de code reviews e melhoria contínua das soluções.


O que buscamos


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e/ou configuração na plataforma ServiceNow;
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript (base da plataforma);
  • Experiência com criação de workflows, business rules, client scripts e UI policies;
  • Familiaridade com módulos como ITSM, ITOM, CSM ou similares;
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST/SOAP;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados dentro da plataforma;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com práticas de ITIL é um diferencial;
  • Experiência com CI/CD e DevOps para ServiceNow é um diferencial;
  • Certificações ServiceNow serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos


  • Capacidade de entender e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas;
  • Colaboração e comunicação com diferentes áreas;
  • Proatividade e senso de dono;
  • Capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas;
  • Interesse por inovação e evolução contínua na plataforma;
  • Organização e autonomia na gestão do trabalho.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: CPM (Cloud PM)
description:
CPM (Cloud PM)

Brazil (Remote)

Contract

We have an urgent request for a Cloud Program Manager (CPM) role in Brazil via LATAM Flex. Assignment details below:


• Start Date: ASAP

• Time Zone: GMT-3

• Location Requirements: Brazil remote (Sao Paulo preferred)

• Language Requirements: Portuguese, Spanish, and English fluency required

• Skillset:

o Project Management, SCRUM, stakeholder management

o Program Governance & Risk Management: Implement robust governance for complex, interconnected projects, proactively managing scope, budget, and timelines while mitigating risks on both waterfall and agile projects.

o Stakeholder Management & Communication: Expertly manage and communicate with diverse stakeholders, from engineers to executives, ensuring alignment and managing expectations. Business & Strategic Acumen: Connect program outcomes to tangible business value (e.g., ROI, TCO), thinking beyond project schedules to drive strategic customer goals.

o Technical Background: Possess solid cloud technology knowledge (infra, data, dev) to facilitate technical discussions, understand dependencies, and earn the trust of engineering teams.


JD


Key Responsibilities

1. Program Governance & Risk Management

• Design and implement robust governance frameworks for interconnected, multi-stream projects.

• Maintain a rigorous pulse on scope, budget, and timelines across both Waterfall and Agile methodologies.

• Identify, quantify, and mitigate risks before they become blockers, ensuring program stability in volatile environments.

2. Stakeholder Management & Communication

• Act as the primary liaison between engineering teams, product owners, and the executive suite.

• Translate technical complexities into actionable business insights for non-technical stakeholders.

• Expertly manage expectations and maintain alignment across diverse global teams.

3. Strategic & Business Acumen

• Move beyond the Gantt chart to demonstrate tangible business value, focusing on metrics like ROI (Return on Investment) and TCO (Total Cost of Ownership).

• Partner with leadership to ensure program outcomes directly support the customer’s strategic goals and bottom line.

4. Technical Leadership

• Leverage a solid background in Cloud Technology (Infrastructure, Data, and Dev) to lead technical dependency discussions.

• Project Management, SCRUM, stakeholder management

Business & Strategic Acumen: Connect program outcomes to tangible business value (e.g., ROI, TCO), thinking beyond project schedules to drive strategic customer goals.

• Technical Background: Possess solid cloud technology knowledge (infra, data, dev) to facilitate technical discussions, understand dependencies, and earn the trust of engineering teams.

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. Banco de Talentos | Engenharia de Dados


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Engenharia de Dados, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos complexos, ambientes de alta volumetria e ecossistemas de dados modernos.


Se você busca desafios técnicos relevantes, trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e construir soluções escaláveis, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e eficientes;
  • Trabalhar com ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT);
  • Construir e evoluir arquiteturas de dados modernas (Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Lakehouses);
  • Garantir qualidade, governança e confiabilidade dos dados;
  • Atuar com processamento de dados em batch e streaming;
  • Integrar diferentes fontes de dados e sistemas;
  • Colaborar com times de dados, analytics, produto e engenharia;
  • Contribuir com boas práticas de engenharia, performance e observabilidade de dados.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com engenharia de dados e construção de pipelines;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Python, SQL e/ou Scala;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de processamento de dados (Spark, Databricks, etc.);
  • Vivência com orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect, ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e otimização de consultas;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Experiência com soluções de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) voltadas a dados;
  • Familiaridade com mensageria e streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, etc.) é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e arquitetura de dados;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Certificações em cloud ou dados (como AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, entre outras) serão consideradas um diferencial.

  • Pensamento analítico e forte capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade e senso de dono sobre as soluções;
  • Colaboração com times multidisciplinares;

  • Organização e autonomia na gestão do trabalho.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
Company Description

ONDA Creative Studio is a format development and production studio based in London, producing content for creators and brands across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and beyond. We’re hiring a senior video editor to join the team on a part-time retainer basis.


The Role

You’ll be the lead editor across multiple creator and brand projects. The primary focus is a recurring live dating show format filmed in front of a live audience — approximately 90 minutes, filmed with 4 cameras, edited into a 45-60 minute hero video plus 4-5 short-form cutdowns. Beyond this, you’ll edit long-form YouTube content, short-form brand and creator videos, fitness content, social-first reels, and campaign pieces for clients across a range of industries and platforms.


What You'll Do

  • Edit long-form content (45-60 min) from unscripted, multi-camera live footage. Build narrative, manage pacing, create hooks
  • Cut short-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and LinkedIn — platform-native edits with hooks, captions, and pacing
  • Sync and assemble multicam footage (4 camera angles) from live events
  • Sound design and colour grade to a broadcast-ready standard
  • Edit across a variety of content types: creator, brand partnership, fitness, talking head, social-first, and event content
  • Work within DaVinci Resolve shared project environments where possible, so timelines are accessible to the wider team
  • Use AI tools (specifically Higgsfield) for short-form content workflows where appropriate


What We're Looking For

  • Strong long-form editing skills (15+ min). You understand pacing, retention, hooks, and storytelling from raw unscripted material. Show us your best work
  • Strong short-form editing instinct. You know what makes someone stop scrolling. Platform-native editing for vertical and horizontal formats
  • DaVinci Resolve proficiency is strongly preferred. Shared project experience is a major plus. Not a dealbreaker, but a significant advantage
  • Multicam editing experience is a bonus, ideally from live events, reality TV, or unscripted formats
  • Competent sound design and colour grading. Your grades should be clean and your audio broadcast-ready
  • Self-directed. You can take a rough brief and deliver a polished first cut without needing frame-by-frame instructions
  • Reliable. You deliver when you say you will. If something changes, you communicate before the deadline, not after
  • Open to AI-assisted workflows. Specifically Higgsfield for short-form content. You don’t need to be an expert, but you need to be curious
  • Politically impartial and professional. ONDA works with clients across a range of industries, causes, and viewpoints. This role requires a professional, unbiased approach to all content — the work is the work, regardless of subject matter


Details

HOURS: Part-time (roughly 30 hours per week)

RATE: Competitive monthly retainer, based on experience and portfolio strength

LOCATION: Fully remote. Any timezone. Deadlines are the measure, not hours

SOFTWARE: DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred

DURATION: Ongoing, with a 4-week paid trial period

START: May 2026

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver soluções baseadas em LLMs, incluindo RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de indexação, recuperação e ranking de informação.
  • Criar e otimizar prompts visando qualidade, consistência e segurança das respostas.
  • Construir APIs de IA utilizando FastAPI.
  • Integrar modelos de linguagem a sistemas existentes.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados e inferência.
  • Avaliar e monitorar desempenho de sistemas de IA em produção.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente ágil seguindo práticas de SCRUM.

Requisitos:

  • Python + ML/DL (PyTorch)
  • SQL + modelagem de dados
  • Estatística
  • LLMs + RAG + embeddings
  • APIs de IA (OpenAI, etc.)
  • Docker + Git
  • Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • MLOps / LLMOps

Diferenciais:

  • Vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate, PGVector)
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex
  • Sistemas de recomendação modernos
  • Avaliação de LLMs

title: BackOffice
description:
Descrição do Cargo: Auxiliar nas demandas do departamento comercial, Cadastrar clientes no sistema, Cadastrar propostas comerciais no sistema, Consultar CDL (SPC e Serasa) após a proposta ser aprovada, antes da emissão do contrato, Emitir novos contratos após aprovação de propostas, Acompanhamento de assinatura eletrônica de contratos e aditivos, Emitir aditivos a maior, a menor, de renovação, Atualizar parcelas de contratos e aditivos após a entrega, e realizar ajustes quando necessário, com orientação do consultor comercial, Solicitar cotação de equipamento aos fornecedores quando necessário, Repassar informações do fechamento do contrato ao setor operacional para realização do serviço, Encerrar contratos no sistema, Solicitar ao setor operacional a retirada de equipamento em caso de encerramento de contrato ou aditivo menor, Solicitar ao setor operacional a entrega de equipamento ou realização de serviços, Arquivar contratos assinados, Fazer requisições de equipamentos para o estoque, Enviar pedidos ou contratos ao financeiro para faturamento, Arquivar documentos do departamento comercial, Solicitar cotação de logística de viagem para envio de propostas, Comparecer às reuniões e organizar atas relacionadas a pendências de tratativas comerciais, Fazer boletim de medição, Realizar pós-venda com o cliente após a realização do serviço.


  • Operações de BackOffice: Experiência em rotinas administrativas e organização de processos internos para suporte operacional.
  • Comunicação e Atendimento ao Cliente: Habilidades claras de comunicação escrita e verbal, além de experiência no atendimento ao cliente para lidar com demandas de forma profissional e eficiente.
  • Finanças e Vendas: Conhecimento em rotinas financeiras e no suporte a equipes de vendas.
  • Desejável formação em Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas relacionadas, além de habilidades em ferramentas como Excel e sistemas CRM.

title: Assistente de Vendas (Inglês Fluente)
description:
International Sales Assistant | Remote & Fluent English – C1


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. sales teams. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Sales Assistant with strong English skills to support sales operations and outbound prospecting.


This is a fully remote role with daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear path toward an international sales career.


What We Offer


  • Monthly compensation of R$4,000
  • 100% remote, supporting U.S. sales teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12 PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Real long-term position
  • Possibility of growth opportunities (SDR, Account Executive, Leadership)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Support outbound prospecting campaigns for U.S. clients
  • Execute prospecting activities (calls, emails, messages, follow-ups)
  • Qualify B2B leads and maintain an updated pipeline
  • Participate in sales meetings and prepare support materials
  • Log activities and metrics in CRM systems (HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)
  • Assist with administrative sales routines
  • Follow defined processes and KPIs consistently


What We’re Looking For


  • Advanced English (C1) — strong verbal and written communication
  • Highly organized and able to multitask
  • Resilient, proactive, and goal-oriented profile
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments
  • Availability to work the proposed shift


Nice to Have


  • Experience in outbound prospecting, B2B/B2C sales, or SDR roles
  • Familiarity with CRMs and sales automation tools
  • Fast learner and tech-savvy mindset
  • KPI-driven profile


Technical Requirements


  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) and 12GB+ RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Professional headset
  • Quiet home office environment


Build your international sales career.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a high-performance environment.

description:
Venha fazer parte de um time inovador como como Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend .NET Pl, dentro de um ambiente que valoriza espírito empreendedor, autonomia, agilidade, foco no cliente, excelência e visão de longo prazo e inconformismo, num projeto de PIX, garantindo a segurança e eficiência das operações financeiras.

  • Experiência com testes unitários (TDD)

  • Perfil colaborativo
  • Senso de dono
  • Comprometimento e responsabilidade com prazos e horários
  • Proatividade

title: Engenheiro(a) de dados Sênior- Azure Fabric
description:
• Projetar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis em cloud (Azure Fabric, Databricks)
  • ● Desenhar pipelines de ingestão em tempo real e batch (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service
  • Bus)
  • ● Modelar Data Lakehouses com Delta Lake e otimizar particionamento
  • ● Definir estratégias de governança e segurança (Purview, RBAC, data lineage)
  • ● Migração e Modernização
  • ● Converter sistemas legados para plataformas modernas
  • ● Traduzir lógica complexa de stored procedures para PySpark/SQL
  • ● Validar integridade de dados pós-migração e corrigir discrepâncias
  • ● Implementar processos de delta load e CDC (Change Data Capture)
  • ● Performance e Qualidade
  • ● Otimizar queries e processamentos para grande volume de dados
  • ● Estabelecer deduplicação e validação de schemas
  • ● Implementar monitoramento e observabilidade (Application Insights)
  • ● Documentação e Colaboração
  • ● Documentar arquiteturas com diagramas técnicos
  • ● Criar mapeamentos DE-PARA entre sistemas legados e novos
  • ● Trabalhar com stakeholders de negócio e times de BI/analytics

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

● PySpark / Apache Spark (transformações complexas, window functions, joins)

● SQL avançado (CTEs, window functions, otimização)

● Microsoft Fabric e Databricks (Lakehouse, Delta Lake)

● Azure (Event Hubs, Storage, Data Factory, Key Vault)

● Modelagem dimensional e normalização

● Git e CI/CD

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS DESEJÁVEIS

● Kafka e streaming em tempo reale NRT

● Power BI (Direct Lake, DAX)

● Oracle Siebel ou CRMs enterprise

● Python para automação

● Schemas JSON/Parquet

● Microsoft Purview

OUTROS DIFERENCIAIS

● Experiência com migração de sistemas legados

● Redução de custos operacionais e FinOps

● Certificações Azure (DP-203, AZ-305)

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term

Type: PJ


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT data pipelines using Python and SQL
  • Lead migration of Adobe-based pipelines to GCP/BigQuery
  • Develop event-driven ingestion pipelines for large-scale data processing
  • Integrate and transform datasets (including media/streaming data) into data warehouses
  • Manage and orchestrate workflows using Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer
  • Ensure data quality, validation, and reconciliation across pipelines
  • Optimize BigQuery performance, storage, and cost efficiency
  • Work across hybrid cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Snowflake)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable data solutions
  • Maintain clear technical documentation and best practices


Required Skills & Experience

  • 7–9 years of hands-on experience in data engineering

Strong expertise in:

  • Python (data pipelines, scripting, transformation)
  • SQL (advanced queries, performance tuning)
  • Apache Airflow (DAGs, scheduling, orchestration)
  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP) & BigQuery
  • Cloud Composer (managed Airflow)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, and automation workflows

Strong understanding of:

  • Data warehousing (star schema, dimensional modeling)
  • ETL/ELT architecture
  • Data quality frameworks and validation techniques


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Adobe Analytics / Adobe Experience Platform
  • Exposure to AWS and Snowflake in multi-cloud environments
  • Hands-on experience with BigQuery cost optimization
  • Knowledge of media, streaming, or event-based data pipelines

title: Analista SAP ABAP
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional Sênior em SAP ABAP para atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento de soluções, com foco em projetos complexos e ambientes modernos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento técnico, garantindo qualidade, performance e boas práticas, além de atuar na definição de arquitetura e apoio ao time.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver soluções complexas em ABAP (RICEFW);
  • Atuar com tecnologias modernas como SAP HANA (CDS, AMDP) e OData;
  • Definir padrões técnicos e realizar code review;
  • Desenvolver integrações (SAP PI/PO ou Integration Suite/BTP);
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time (mentoria);
  • Atuar em troubleshooting e incidentes críticos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com ABAP;
  • Vivência com S/4HANA;
  • Domínio de ABAP OO;
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5 e serviços OData;
  • Experiência com Adobe Forms.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP;
  • Certificações SAP;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript/Node.js.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC).


Primary Job Duties:

  • Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time.
  • Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work.
  • Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision.
  • Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design.
  • Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures.
  • Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings.
  • Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis.
  • Improve system reliability through automation and observability.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git).
  • Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly.
  • Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required.
  • Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity.
  • AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer.
  • Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
  • Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly.
  • Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.


This role starts at R$10,000 per month

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: Analista de Redes Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa dedicada e com vontade de fazer a diferença para atuar na área de Infra. Se você ama tecnologia, gosta de desafios e acredita no poder da colaboração para alcançar grandes resultados, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, implementar e gerenciar a infraestrutura de rede para garantir a disponibilidade e o desempenho dos serviços de TI.
  • Monitorar o tráfego de rede e resolver problemas de conectividade e desempenho.
  • Configurar e manter firewalls, switches, roteadores e outros equipamentos de rede.
  • Colaborar com equipes de segurança para implementar políticas de segurança de rede.
  • Realizar auditorias e avaliações de desempenho da infraestrutura de rede.
  • Atualizar e manter documentação técnica da rede.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco e implementar soluções para mitigar vulnerabilidades na rede.
  • Realizar diagnósticos de incidentes e problemas de redes de telecomunicações.
  • Tomar ações de forma proativa ou por aviso do sistema de ITSM, para recuperação dos serviços.
  • Atuar diretamente na solução de problemas relacionados com falhas das redes, delimitando e corrigindo
  • falhas.
  • Analisar e corrigir problemas de configuração em equipamentos de redes de dados.
  • Experiência em configurar e gerenciar equipamentos Fortinet (firewalls FortiGate, Fortimanager).
  • Conhecimento em políticas de segurança e VPNs Fortinet.
  • Conhecimentos em SDWAN Fortinet.
  • Familiaridade com interfaces e funcionalidades do firewall Palo Alto.
  • Entendimento básico da configuração de regras e de políticas de segurança em Palo Alto.
  • Habilidade em realizar tarefas de diagnóstico simples em dispositivos Palo Alto.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência avançada na área de infraestrutura de rede.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de rede, como TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP e BGP.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de monitoramento de rede e análise de tráfego.
  • Capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos de rede e comunicação.
  • Disponibilidade para suporte fora do horário comercial, se necessário.
  • Gerenciamento de Projetos;
  • Atuação com configuração e suporte de equipamentos de rede (switches e roteadores).
  • Conhecimento da arquitetura, funcionamento e configuração de otimizadores de WAN.
  • Conhecimento da arquitetura, funcionamento e configuração de balanceadores de carga de links
  • e servidores.
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura, funcionamento e configuração de redes sem fio.
  • Conhecimentos em características, métodos e técnicas envolvidas em correlação de eventos
  • (alarmes) nas redes de telecomunicações e análise de troubleshooting de falhas nas redes.
  • Conhecimentos de arquiteturas e implantação de QoS, incluindo Intserv, Diffserv, policy, shaping e priorização de filas através de marcação de pacotes.
  • Planejamento de capacidade.
  • Administração de ativos de rede.
  • Desenvolvimento de análises de tráfego e diagnóstico das operações de rede de dados.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de elementos através do protocolo SNMP.
  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Desenvolvedor Sharepoint

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) + DevOp:

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT


Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um profissional SRE com habilidades em DevOps para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e desempenho das nossas aplicações e infraestrutura. Este profissional atuará em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para promover uma cultura de automação e melhoria contínua.


Responsabilidades:

- Garantir a disponibilidade e a performance das aplicações e serviços, monitorando métricas e implementando soluções proativas.

- Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para criar e implementar práticas de DevOps, como CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua).

- Automatizar processos de infraestrutura utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares.

- Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, etc.).

- Responder a incidentes e realizar análises de causa raiz para melhorar a confiabilidade do sistema.

- Participar da definição e implementação de políticas de segurança e conformidade.

- Ajudar na gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e configurações de infraestrutura.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em práticas de SRE e DevOps.

- Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e scripts (Python, Go, Bash, etc.).

- Experiência com ferramentas de automação de infraestrutura (Terraform, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, etc.).

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).

- Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Habilidade em solucionar problemas e trabalhar de forma independente.

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em gestão de incidentes e resposta a emergências.

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

- Certificações relevantes (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, etc.).

- Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em DevOps (DevSecOps).

title: Business System Analyst
description:
Type: 12 Month Contract

Location: Central and South America Fully Remote

Rate: $19/hr - $23/hr



Job Description

Insight Global is seeking a Business Systems Analyst to support AI‑driven transformation initiatives across underwriting, claims, and operations at a commercial insurance company. This role will act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring AI solutions are aligned to real operational needs and deliver measurable value. Day‑to‑day, the BSA will gather and document detailed business requirements, perform gap analysis and process mapping, define future‑state workflows enabled by AI, and partner with QA and delivery teams on testing and validation. The ideal candidate brings strong business analysis experience on technical projects and excels at translating business problems into clear, actionable requirements. The successful candidate will have a business focused functional background and is expected to leverage the technical/AI focused team members to develop solutions. We are seeking an international resource based in LATAM to work closely with a team in Canada on mountain standard time. This is a fully remote 12 month engagement.

Required Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of Business Analyst or Business Systems Analyst experience with experience working in the insurance industry

• Strong experience with requirements documentation and BRDs

• Proven experience with process mapping and gap analysis

• Experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria

• Hands‑on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Experience working in Agile environments

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


About the Role

The Data Engineering team is a software-centric group responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems that power a large marketplace platform. We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer who can take ownership of end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

This is a coding-heavy role that goes beyond traditional data engineering, requiring strong architectural design and the ability to build robust integrations between internal microservices and external partner APIs, in addition to scalable data pipelines.

You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Product, and Core Engineering teams to develop cutting-edge solutions that enhance the company’s data platform capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop code-driven interfaces between the data platform and internal/external services
  • Own projects from requirements gathering through production deployment and monitoring
  • Build scalable data transformations using dbt
  • Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, focusing on reliability and maintainability
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to improve development speed and code quality
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to solve complex data challenges


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design
  • Strong programming skills with the ability to write production-grade, modular Python code
  • Expert-level SQL skills, including complex data modeling and BigQuery performance optimization
  • Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow, etc.)
  • Proven experience building integrations with APIs and working with streaming platforms
  • Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing, and project organization)
  • Experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality
  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and Docker/Kubernetes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with data design patterns such as Medallion architecture
  • Experience with Terraform and/or Atlantis


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field

title: Strategy Consultant
description:
Company Description

Marais Advisory is a boutique consulting firm specializing in AI implementation and competitive intelligence for enterprise clients. The firm emphasizes practical AI integration within existing infrastructure to drive strategic business transformation. With expertise in AWS, GCP, and Azure, Marais Advisory delivers end-to-end solutions covering enterprise AI roadmaps, evaluation frameworks, and multi-agent systems for competitive intelligence. The firm partners with organizations ranging from private equity to telecommunications, tailoring solutions like ServiceNow integrations and automated competitive intelligence systems. Marais Advisory prides itself on a results-driven approach, combining technical excellence and strategic insight to enable clients to seamlessly adapt in the AI era.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Strategy Consultant. The Strategy Consultant will be responsible for advising clients on AI strategy, implementing data-driven solutions, and conducting research in fields like natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing complex datasets, designing AI roadmaps, creating evaluation frameworks, and leveraging pattern recognition techniques. The Consultant will also collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to ensure the practical deployment of AI solutions.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP)
  • Experience in Data Science and Pattern Recognition methodologies
  • Strong consulting skills with the ability to advise on AI strategies and business integration
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, and programming skills in Python or related technologies
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills to interface with diverse stakeholders
  • Relevant professional experience in AI, data science, or enterprise technology consulting
  • A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field is preferred

title: Data Analyst
description:
About The Role


You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

This is not just a dashboarding role. You’ll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads.

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption
  • Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod
  • Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs
  • Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities
  • Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery
  • Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.)
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

  • Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
  • Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
  • Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
  • Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
  • Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
  • Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
  • Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
  • Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
  • Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Senior React Native Developer (Cross-Platform, Salesforce Mobile SDK)
description:
Role: Senior React Native Developer (Cross-Platform, Salesforce Mobile SDK)

Remote (Costa Rica, Brazil or Mexico)

Contract


Role Purpose


As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyperscale heavy application landscape


Key Responsibilities


• Cross Platform Development Design and develop robust mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native

• Salesforce Integration Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds

• Offline Data Management Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB Salesforce Smart Store and Smart Sync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization

• Computer Vision Integration Implement image processing and computer vision features eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using OpenCV within the mobile environment

• State Management Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit

• Experience Engineering Build high-fidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for field force users and consumers adhering to global brand standards

• Version Control CICD Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines

• Emerging Tech Pilots Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scale hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI

• Senior Developer Specifics Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews optimize app performance memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices


Primary Skills Must-Have

• Core Framework Expertlevel proficiency in React Native JavaScript TypeScript

• Salesforce Mobile Handson experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB

• State Management Deep understanding of Redux for enterprise scale mobile apps

• Computer Vision Experience integrating OpenCV or similar C Native modules into React Native applications

• Version Control Advanced proficiency in GitHub workflows and Git based collaboration


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

• Native Modules Ability to write Native Bridges in Swift Objective C iOS or Java Kotlin Android

• Hyper scaler Exposure Experience connecting mobile apps to GCP Azure backend services Cloud Run App Services

• Salesforce Platform Familiarity with Apex SOQL and Salesforce Lightning Web Components LWC

• Mobile Security Knowledge of OAuth2 Certificate Pinning and secure local storage patterns

• FMCG Domain Understanding of retail execution van sales or field force automation workflows


Apply or send your resume to

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

title: Operations Founder / Entrepreneur in Residence – 100% Remote
description:
Apply here:


Are you an operator-founder who knows how to build from zero and turn ideas into execution? We’re looking for an entrepreneurial operator to join a venture studio working across multiple industries, including education, finance, healthcare, and gaming.



About the Role


You’ll work directly with the venture studio to launch and scale new projects. This role is hands-on and execution-focused, building systems, defining processes, and getting early-stage operations off the ground.


You won’t just manage, you’ll build.



What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and implement operational systems from scratch across multiple ventures
  • Design and optimize processes to support early-stage growth
  • Take ownership of launching new projects and getting them operational
  • Work closely with founders and stakeholders to execute business ideas
  • Identify bottlenecks and create scalable solutions
  • Manage cross-functional workflows across different industries
  • Drive execution across product, operations, and early go-to-market efforts
  • Bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, fast-moving environments


What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience building or founding a company
  • Strong operator mindset with the ability to execute, not just strategize
  • Experience in early-stage environments (startup, venture studio, etc.)
  • Ability to build systems, processes, and workflows from zero
  • Comfortable working across multiple industries and projects
  • Tech founder or strong technical background is highly preferred
  • Highly autonomous, proactive, and resourceful
  • Fluent English
  • Spanish is a strong plus

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Customer Service Representative

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.

Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.


The Role

This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.

You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
  • You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
  • You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
  • You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
  • You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You avoid dealing with difficult customers
  • You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
  • You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms


What You'll Do

Customer Support Execution

  • Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
  • Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
  • Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice

Social Media Support

  • Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency

Order & Refund Management

  • Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
  • Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed

Conflict Resolution

  • Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
  • Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
  • Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations


Requirements

Must have:

  • Experience in customer service (ecommerce or DTC preferred)
  • Strong written communication skills in English
  • Experience handling social media interactions is a strong plus
  • High attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM.
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business

Ready to Apply?

If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

title: Senior Mobile Developer – React Native
description:
Role: Senior Mobile Developer – React Native

Remote (Brazil or Mexico or Costa Rica)

Contract


Responsibilities

• Cross Platform Development Expertlevel proficiency in React Native for building high-performance reusable components for both iOS and Android

• State Management Mastery of Redux MobX or React Context API for managing complex application states and offline data persistence

• Native Modules Experience writing Native Bridges Java Kotlin for Android ObjectiveCSwift for iOS to access device specific features not covered by standard React Native APIs

• Performance Optimization Deep expertise in optimizing app render times memory usage and battery consumption

• Navigation Proficiency with React Navigation or React Native Navigation for complex screen flows

• Mobile Ecosystem Tooling

• Build Tools Expert use of Metro Bundler Xcode and Android Studio for building debugging and profiling applications

• App Store Management Experience managing the end-to-end release process for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store including TestFlight and Beta testing

• Code Push Proficiency in using Microsoft Code Push for overtheair OTA updates to bypass traditional store review cycles for critical hotfixes


Secondary Technical Skills Integration DevOps

• Backend API Integration

• REST GraphQL Deep understanding of consuming complex APIs handling authentication OAuth2JWT and managing data synchronization

• Offline First Architecture Experience implementing offline capabilities using Watermelon DB Realm or SQLite to support field users with intermittent connectivity

• Mobile DevOps Quality

• CICD Pipelines Experience with Fastlane Bit rise or Azure DevOps for automated mobile build and deployment pipelines

• Testing Proficiency in Jest for unit testing and Detox or Appium for end-to-end E2E automation

• Crash Analytics Expert use of Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry to monitor app health and perform proactive bug fixing


Key Responsibilities AMS Context

• Mobile App Support Lead the resolution of Tier 2 and Tier 3 incidents affecting global mobile users from UI glitches to critical sync failures

• OS Compatibility Proactively manage app updates to ensure compatibility with the latest iOS and Android versions and hardware releases

• Complex Change Requests Translate requirements from Sales and Marketing leads into technical mobile features Design develop and test enhancements

• Root Cause Analysis RCA Perform deep dive analysis on app crashes API timeouts or data inconsistencies implementing permanent architectural fixes

• SLA Stewardship Ensure all mobile services meet strict Service Level Agreements SLAs for our 247 global field operations

• Technical Mentorship Act as the Subject Matter Expert SME for React Native in the India hub providing guidance to junior developers and UIUX designers


Preferred Skills

• Experience with TypeScript for type safe React Native development

• Familiarity with SAP Fiori for mobile or SAP Mobile Services

• Knowledge of Bluetooth IoT integration for warehouse scanning applications

• Experience with mobile security best practices biometrics certificate pinning

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.
